name: MEVBOTa47b
fix_description: In receiveFlashLoan (0xf04f2707), no validation that msg.sender is the legitimate Balancer Vault. Any caller can invoke this callback. Add require(msg.sender == BALANCER_VAULT).
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step drain involving an Aave flash loan, repeated arbitrary low-level calls into a vulnerable router, and Curve pool swaps to convert/drain assets, so it requires understanding protocol-specific token/pool interactions rather than just spotting a basic bug. The exploit flow is still fairly direct and the PoC is short, so it is not hard, but an auditor would likely need more than a trivial amount of time to reconstruct the attack.
